content.value: A set of ceramic bars of 5mm cross-section and 100mm length are tested in 3-point bend with(15) the outer loading points spanning 90mm. This data was analyzed to give a mean MOR of 380MPa and a Weibull modulus of 14.
Determine the mean expected stress for an identical sample set tested in 4-point bend with the outer and inner loading points spanning 90mm and 30mm respectively.
(Answer ANY THREE questions from this section in answer script B)
